_comment: Refresh-cadence tiers — single source of truth for which countries get refreshed how often. Edit this when promoting/demoting a country across tiers (e.g., a frontier market with a major reform may move B→A for one cycle). Country code → playbook directory must match skills/property-deep-dive/countries/<code>/playbook.md. The sum of all tier codes must equal the total country count in config/_regions.json (currently 121).

A.label: Quarterly refresh
A.rationale: High-volume foreign-buyer markets with frequent regulatory change. Tax/visa/rental rules shift mid-year; numeric benchmarks (€/m², HPI) move quarterly.

B.label: Semi-annual refresh
B.rationale: Stable mid-volume markets. Numbers drift slowly; major reforms hit a 6-month cycle reliably.

C.label: Annual refresh
C.rationale: Smaller markets, microstates, frontier jurisdictions. Foundational data (cadastre, tax authority) is stable across calendar years; targeted patches happen via regulatory-watch override, not the cadence.

promotion_rules._comment: When a Tier-1 or Tier-2 regulatory-watch entry lands for a Tier-B or Tier-C country, that country is auto-promoted to Tier-A for the NEXT refresh cycle only, then reverts. Tracked via the regulatory-watch-revisit workflow.
promotion_rules.regwatch_promotion: any country with a Tier-1 or Tier-2 regulatory-watch entry enacted in the last 90 days runs as Tier-A for the next cycle
promotion_rules.manual_override: /property-deep-dive --update --tier=A --include=<iso2> forces inclusion regardless of canonical tier
